summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Artrom Steel Tubes S.A. from GLGH Steel, LLC for EUR 86 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis with normalized working capital. The target is a Romanian seamless steel pipe manufacturer with ~450k-ton steelmaking and 200k-ton pipe rolling capacity. The transaction is subject to EU competition clearance and Romanian approvals; closing expected Q4 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. This acquisition expands Tenaris's European industrial pipe product range. Watch for regulatory delays or conditions from EU authorities; risk-arb focuses on clearance timing.
